app.name: Geezy
app.long_description: Hold sideways. A: two-second charge, compression, accelerating strobe and voxel lock; release for 1.2-4x impulse. B: eased inversion graphics only while held; each press advances the pattern. 1+Plus: toggle HUD. 1/2 tap on release: palette/scene. Hold 1 + direction: material; 2 + direction: formation; 1+2 + direction: background. 1+2 + diagonals: lattice, gates, blades or diagonal trusses. A+1: reflection; A+2: subjects only; B+1: six geometric masks; B+2: motion only. Hold then release both 1+2: remix. Seeded chrome knots, sliced monoliths, mechanical rings, voxel glyphs and superformula sculptures. True wire-and-point skin. Single, pair, trinity and satellite layouts. Thick polygon warp tunnel; full enclosing dome at gear 3 or background 2. Recursive zoom/rotation trails with a black cutoff. Orbit/dolly camera, RGB split and corner telemetry. D-pad: tap for directional impulse, hold for 5x boost, faster subject spin and off-center aim. B + D-pad: look away; release to return. Plus/Minus: speed and density gear 0-3. Plus and Minus together: reset. Optional shake: 2.5x impulse. HOME: exit. No sensor bar required.
